H7354.name: Rachel
H7354.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7354.brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin
H7354.short: Rachel was the beloved wife of Jacob, and the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.

H7343.name: Rahab
H7343.brief: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho
H7343.short: Rahab, a Canaanite woman from Jericho, hid the Israelite spies and was spared during the city's destruction.

H7357.name: Raham
H7357.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7357.brief: Son of Shema and founder of Jorkeam, of Judah
H7357.short: Raham was the son of Shema and the father or founder of Jorkeam, from the tribe of Judah.

H7394H.name: Rechab
H7394H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7394H.brief: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God
H7394H.short: Rechab was the ancestor of the Rechabites, a nomadic tribe known for their faithfulness to God's commands.

H7394G.name: Rechab
H7394G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7394G.brief: A captain of Ishbosheth's army, with his brother Baanah
H7394G.short: Rechab and his brother Baanah were captains in Ishbosheth's army during the time of David.

H7394I.name: Rechab
H7394I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7394I.brief: Father of Malchijah, who repaired the Dung Gate
H7394I.short: Rechab was the father of Malchijah, who repaired the Dung Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

H7345.name: Rehabiah
H7345.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7345.brief: Son of Eliezer, grandson of Moses, a Levite
H7345.short: Rehabiah was the son of Eliezer and grandson of Moses, a Levite with many descendants.

H7340I.name: Rehob
H7340I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7340I.brief: Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah
H7340I.short: Rehob was the father of Hadadezer, the king of Zobah, who was defeated by King David.

H7340J.name: Rehob
H7340J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7340J.brief: One of the leaders who sealed the covenant
H7340J.short: Rehob was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H7346.name: Rehoboam
H7346.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchyand Divided Monarchy
H7346.brief: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah
H7346.short: Rehoboam was the son of Solomon and the first king of Judah after the division of the kingdom.

H7348A.name: Rehum
H7348A.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7348A.brief: One of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel
H7348A.short: Rehum (or Harim or Nehum) was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian exile.

H7348B.name: Rehum
H7348B.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7348B.brief: A Persian official who wrote to King Artaxerxes
H7348B.short: Rehum was a Persian official who wrote to King Artaxerxes, attempting to stop the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

H7348H.name: Rehum
H7348H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7348H.brief: One who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H7348H.short: Rehum was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H7348G.name: Rehum
H7348G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7348G.brief: A Levite who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem
H7348G.short: Rehum was a Levite who helped repair a section of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H7331.name: Rezon
H7331.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7331.brief: Son of Eliada, adversary of Solomon
H7331.short: Rezon, son of Eliada, was an adversary of Solomon who reigned over Aram (Syria) in Damascus.

H7380.name: Ribai
H7380.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H7380.brief: Father of Ittai, one of David's mighty men
H7380.short: Ribai was the father of Ittai the Gibeathite, one of David's mighty men.

H7384B.name: Riphath
H7384B.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7384B.brief: Son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth
H7384B.short: Riphath was a son of Gomer and grandson of Japheth, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H7303.name: Rohgah
H7303.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7303.brief: Son of Shomer, of the tribe of Asher
H7303.short: Rohgah was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H7320.name: Romamti-ezer
H7320.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7320.brief: Son of Heman, a Levitical singer
H7320.short: Romamti-ezer was a son of Heman and a Levitical singer during the reign of King David.

H7327.name: Ruth
H7327.brief: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus
H7327.short: Ruth was a Moabite woman who married Boaz and became an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H7342G.name: Broad Wall
H7342G.short: The Broad Wall was a section of Jerusalem's wall rebuilt during Nehemiah's time.

H7316G.name: Dumah
H7316G.brief: A city in the hill country of Judah.
H7316G.short: Dumah, a city located in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:52">Joshua 15:52</ref>).

H7397B.name: Recah
H7397B.short: Recah was a descendant of Judah through Caleb (<ref="1Ch. 4:12">1Ch. 4:12</ref>).

H7340G.name: Rehob
H7340G.brief: City on the border of Asher
H7340G.short: Rehob was a city on the northern border of the territory allotted to the tribe of Asher (<ref="Jos. 19:28">Jos. 19:28</ref>).

H7340H.name: Rehob
H7340H.short: Rehob was a Levitical city within the territory of Asher (<ref="Jos. 19:30; 21:31; 1Ch. 6:75">Jos. 19:30; 21:31; 1Ch. 6:75</ref>).

H7344G.name: Rehoboth
H7344G.short: Rehoboth was the name of a well dug by Isaac where he found room and water (<ref="Gen. 26:22">Gen. 26:22</ref>).

H7344H.name: Rehoboth
H7344H.brief: City associated with an Edomite king
H7344H.short: Rehoboth was a city associated with Shaul, an Edomite king (<ref="Gen. 36:37; 1Ch. 1:48">Gen. 36:37; 1Ch. 1:48</ref>).
